data.title: 毒蛇 · 客厅沙发的微醺依偎
data.description: 暖色调的静谧客厅内，毒蛇侧坐在宽大的真丝沙发上。贴身的粉白露脐短上衣衬托出纤细柔韧的腰肢，粉色波浪卷发散落在白皙胸口。她单手托腮，翡翠般的碧绿眼眸含着狡黠而甜美的笑意，微咬着下唇向镜头俏皮地眨了眨眼，散发着让人难以抵挡的恶魔系女友魅力。
data.location: dimly lit modern living room with soft ambient light
data.action: 侧坐在宽大的真丝沙发上，贴身的粉白露脐短上衣衬托出纤细柔韧的腰肢
data.lighting: soft warm indoor downlights paired with pink neon mood strip along baseboards
data.promptProse: Seated sideways across a wide velvet sofa in a softly lit living room, Viper rests her chin on one palm and gives a playful wink while biting her lower lip. Warm ambient light highlights her relaxed posture and teasing glance.
data.animaCaption: Lounging sideways on a plush velvet sofa in her tight pink crop top, open cropped bolero, and pleated miniskirt, she props her cheek on one hand and winks teasingly at the viewer while lightly biting her lower lip in warm room light.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a fitted pink crop top under a cropped black-and-pink bolero jacket with a short pleated miniskirt and thigh-high stockings, baring her midriff, navel, and collarbones.
